items.title: Arista patches new VeloCloud Orchestrator zero-day exploited in attacks
items.snippet: Arista Networks released security updates to patch an actively exploited zero-day vulnerability affecting VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) On-Prem deployments. [...]
items.summary: Arista released updates for an actively exploited zero-day vulnerability affecting VeloCloud Orchestrator On-Prem deployments.

items.title: Microsoft blames ConnectWise attacks on Chinese state hacker using ARTEX AI agents
items.snippet: A Chinese government-aligned hacking group used automated tools to carry out the recent supply chain attack on IT management software company ConnectWise and is using the same techniques to try to compromise organizations around the globe, Microsoft said.
items.summary: Microsoft said a Chinese government-aligned group used automated tools in the ConnectWise supply chain attack and is using similar techniques to target organizations.
items.why: Review exposure to ConnectWise and monitor for automated compromise attempts.

items.title: Microsoft shares how to fix broken Exchange Online EWS apps
items.snippet: Microsoft says IT admins can re-enable the retired Exchange Web Services (EWS) API in Exchange Online to fix EWS apps that have stopped working. [...]
items.summary: Microsoft says IT admins can re-enable the retired Exchange Web Services API to fix Exchange Online apps that stopped working.
items.why: Check whether affected apps depend on EWS before changing Exchange Online settings.

items.title: Machine speed attacks require machine speed detection and response
items.snippet: Attackers can steal credentials and begin exfiltrating data within minutes, often before security teams can respond. Exaforce examines real-world attacks involving stolen GitHub tokens, malicious AI installers, and MFA phishing, explaining why faster detection and automated containment are critical. [...]
items.summary: Exaforce says attackers can steal credentials and start data exfiltration within minutes, citing attacks involving GitHub tokens, malicious AI installers, and MFA phishing.
items.why: Assess detection and response speed for credential theft and data exfiltration.

items.title: Cybercrime crackdown across Africa leads to 1,462 arrests, $105 million seized
items.snippet: More than 1,400 suspected cybercriminals were arrested across Africa this summer as part of a crackdown on the gangs perpetrating online fraud, ransomware and business email compromise attacks, Interpol said.
items.summary: Interpol says a cybercrime crackdown across Africa led to more than 1,400 arrests and $105 million seized.
items.why: Review protections against online fraud, ransomware, and business email compromise.

items.title: eMudhra to Exit Global SSL/TLS Business After 8 Intermediate CA Keys Found Easily Guessable
items.snippet: eMudhra, an Indian certificate authority (CA), will withdraw from its global SSL/TLS certificate business, its board decided on Thursday. The decision came five days after a researcher reported recovering the private keys of eight of its intermediate CA certificates. eMudhra said it will replace affected customers' cer
items.summary: eMudhra says its board decided to exit the global SSL/TLS certificate business after a researcher reported recovering eight easily guessable intermediate CA private keys.
items.why: Check whether your systems trust affected certificates and plan for certificate replacement if needed.

items.title: Pentagon, Lockheed agree to decade-long F-35 framework deal for hundreds of jets
items.snippet: The tentative agreement, which still needs lawmakers’ blessing, covers production and sustainment over the 10 years.
items.summary: The Pentagon and Lockheed agreed to a tentative F-35 framework covering production and sustainment over the next 10 years; lawmakers must still approve it.
items.why: The framework concerns long-term fighter production and sustainment.

items.title: A-4 ‘Super’ Skyhawks Playing The Bad Guys In European Skies
items.snippet: The A-4 Skyhawk, first flown seven decades ago, is famed for its role as a Cold War 'red air' aggressor, and it lives on doing that mission to this day in Europe. The post A-4 ‘Super’ Skyhawks Playing The Bad Guys In European Skies appeared first on TWZ .
items.summary: The A-4 Skyhawk continues to fly red-air aggressor missions in Europe, according to The War Zone.
items.why: The aircraft’s continued use highlights the role of aggressor platforms in training against simulated adversaries.

items.summary: Copenhagen said Denmark would purchase Joint Strike Missiles for its F-35s and a new ground-launched munition from an American firm.

items.title: MDA awards $75M to Long Wall for low-cost, midcourse interceptor testing

items.summary: Long Wall is matching Missile Defense Agency funding with its own capital to continue developing the Cyclops interceptor, according to the company.

items.title: Navy awards Applied Intuition $25M to deploy AI sensor fusion at sea
items.snippet: The Intelligent Perception System will help sailors understand a flood of sensor feeds while collecting data to train improved AI models, the company said.
items.summary: The company says its Intelligent Perception System will help sailors make sense of many sensor feeds and collect data to train improved AI models.
items.why: Sensor fusion can help crews interpret multiple feeds in maritime operations.

items.title: Construction Of Iran’s “Eagle 44” Underground Airbase Hasn’t Stopped Despite War
items.snippet: Satellite imagery depicts new construction and cleared wreckage after strikes at an Iranian airbase with underground hangars and taxiway tunnels. The post Construction Of Iran’s “Eagle 44” Underground Airbase Hasn’t Stopped Despite War appeared first on TWZ .
items.summary: Satellite imagery depicts new construction and cleared wreckage at Iran’s Eagle 44 airbase, which has underground hangars and taxiway tunnels.
items.why: Imagery offers a view of construction and damage at an underground airbase.

items.title: Germany arrests Ukrainian man accused of spying for Russia
items.snippet: Military has raised the threat level of ​Russian sabotage against German troops and facilities.
items.summary: Germany arrested a Ukrainian man accused of spying for Russia; the military raised the threat level of Russian sabotage against German troops and facilities.
items.why: The reported threat highlights security concerns around German military personnel and facilities.

items.title: Europe Is Asking the Wrong Question About Russia’s Hybrid War
items.snippet: Leaders are debating what to call it—rather than what to do.
items.summary: Foreign Policy says European leaders are debating what to call Russia’s hybrid war rather than what to do about it.
items.why: The debate points to a strategic question about how Europe should respond to hybrid warfare.

items.title: Race to update services' computer systems after cyber-security flaw found
items.snippet: Websites were taken offline after the developers of programming language PHP said "critical vulnerabilities" had been discovered.
items.summary: Websites went offline after PHP developers said critical vulnerabilities had been discovered, prompting a race to update services’ computer systems.
items.why: Organizations should check PHP-dependent services and apply relevant updates.

items.title: Germany target of 'intensive' espionage, Merz says after suspected Russian spy arrest
items.snippet: A Ukrainian man was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia - one of several such cases in Germany this year.
items.summary: Merz said Germany is a target of intensive espionage after a Ukrainian man was arrested on suspicion of spying for Russia.
items.why: The report points to espionage concerns affecting Germany.

items.title: Newborn twins fight for survival as conflict fuels Yemen's hunger crisis
items.snippet: Raghad and Raad's family had to flee their home on foot because of the fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis.
items.summary: Raghad and Raad’s family fled on foot because of fighting between pro-government forces and the Houthis, as the newborn twins face Yemen’s hunger crisis.
items.why: The item describes how conflict and displacement intersect with hunger in Yemen.

items.title: Two killed in Houthi attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
items.snippet: It is the latest in a series of attacks by the Houthi movement targeting airports and other sites in the kingdom.
items.summary: Authorities say two people were killed in a Houthi attack on an airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, part of a series targeting sites in the kingdom.
items.why: Repeated attacks on airports and other sites have regional security significance.

items.summary: Al Jazeera reports an Israeli court released nine settler suspects over West Bank attacks as investigations into recent assaults continue.
items.why: The releases and continuing investigations are relevant to the security situation in the West Bank.

items.snippet: The US has pushed back on the IRGC's claims, dismissing them as an attempt to increase oil prices ahead of US elections.

learn.explainer: An intermediate CA key is a private key used by a certificate authority between its root authority and issued certificates. Protecting it helps preserve trust in certificates it signs.
Red air refers to aircraft acting as simulated adversaries in training. The A-4 Skyhawk is described as continuing this aggressor role in Europe.
Hybrid war is a term used for conflict discussed as something beyond a conventional military contest. The item focuses on Europe’s debate about how to respond to Russia’s hybrid war.
